name: Deigan
source:
He is a member of the Oni-menshu, subordinates of Karuma, and is particularly skilled in the field of assassination.
He uses an astonishingly gentle style that makes his body seem to have no mass, allowing him to sneak up on his target from behind and take their head without being noticed. His style relies entirely on surprise attacks and deception, making him the perfect embodiment of the Oni-menshu, a group of assassins.
